jobs.prompt: 16:9 abstract editorial illustration for a graduate-level lecture on the attention mechanism. Visual metaphor only: a single horizontal row of eight evenly spaced solid dots along the lower third of the frame. From one particular dot near the right, thin curved threads arch upward and over to every other dot in the row, and the threads differ dramatically in weight — two of them are thick and solid terracotta, one is medium dusty blue, and the rest are barely visible hairlines in pale warm gray, so the picture reads as one point drawing unequally from all the others. The dots themselves are deep warm ink and identical in size. Warm paper background, soft diffuse light, generous negative space, calm geometric composition, premium academic magazine style. Absolutely no text, no letters, no digits, no labels, no axes, no arrowheads, no charts.
